question: Can an expert discern many fine details in a brief flash of illumination?
premises: A person with clear knowledge of the nature of gems is an expert observer.
Lightning can reveal objects only for a single brief moment.
Even in that brief moment, the expert can pick out many particular details of many gems.
inference: Expert knowledge enables rapid discrimination of numerous particulars even under momentary illumination.
plain_english: Someone with clear knowledge of the nature of gems can, in the brief moment shown by a flash of lightning, pick out those various particular details even among many gems.
